io.github.atrain.aTrain GPL-3.0-or-later MIT aTrain <summary Offline transcription of speech recordings, including speaker diarization, utilizing state-of-the-art machine learning models.
aTrain is a tool for automatically transcribing speech recordings utilizing state-of-the-art machine learning models without uploading any data. It was developed by researchers at the Business Analytics and Data Science-Center at the University of Graz and tested by researchers from the Know-Center Graz.
Features include:
Automatic speech-to-text transcription
Speaker diarization
GPU acceleration with CUDA support
Export transcriptions in various formats, including MAXQDA, ATLAS.ti and nVivo compatible output,
Completely offline - all processing done locally
